clock: completed 1m bar t after parent09:47 fill; decision t+1m; one intended whole-share buy at open of bar starting t+2m before true XNYS close

action.constraints: long-only simplex, no borrowing; old beta cap, SOXL30pct and cash15pct floors are not imposed; both arms must independently produce exactly one whole-share buy of intended asset with positive postfill cash

label: For each funded event at t+2, value of an independent one-buy SOXL or SOXX branch at next US session 09:47 before next action, minus unchanged after-open HOLD branch at the same next open, divided by decision NAV; primary difference SOXL minus SOXX. No common reset; event fees only; discovery label, not final continuous target.
unknown: Original recovery day, incomplete source day, no one-buy whole-share/negative cash arm, terminal next-open unavailable. No fill or future whole-share legality cannot be a decision feature.
stop: Any parent/source/time/fee parity failure or fixed value sign support failure closes this label version. Do not tune size, time, years, risk structure or missingness on realized value. 2021/22 outputs remain sealed for later information-gate testing, not feature discovery.
